assumptions: Used the skill's documented single-agent fallback instead of sub-agents, as requested.
Retained only sale listings within the exact municipality Nové Město nad Metují.
Applied the 1000 m2 minimum to parcel area for houses and land; rows with smaller or unverified parcel area were excluded.
gaps: mmreality.cz surfaced municipality matches, but the relevant generic /nemovitosti/<id>/ pages visible in search were marked inactive, so no MM Reality row was credible enough to retain.

reality.aktualne.cz exposed municipality search-page cards, but I did not recover enough detail-verified parcel data or stable municipality-specific detail URLs for any qualifying row, so nothing from that portal survived filtering.

Several visible municipality listings on supporting portals were excluded because they were chata/chalupa entries labeled as chata, commercial/mixed-use inventory, non-buildable land, or had parcel area below 1000 m2.
